intro: Tampa rewards visitors with waterfront parks, historic streetcars, and easy access to Gulf beaches. Pick how long you have and what you enjoy most.
tour_note: Check the tour page for which entry tickets are included.

notes: TECO Line Streetcar is fare-free and links downtown to Ybor City, roughly every 20 min.
HART buses cover Hillsborough County; local fare about $1.75, commuter express about $2.75.
PSTA buses serve Pinellas County and connect the airport to downtown Tampa.
Ride apps like Uber and Lyft operate; taxis are metered and best booked by app or phone.
Driving is convenient but rush hours (7:30-9:30AM, 3:30-7:30PM) are slow, especially on I-275.
Downtown is walkable; bikes and scooters work for short trips, but summer heat is strong.

busch_gardens.name: Busch Gardens Tampa Bay
busch_gardens.price_text: ≈ $90–140 one-day ticket; check online for date pricing and deals
busch_gardens.hours: Usually 10:00–18:00, later in summer; check the day's calendar
busch_gardens.tip: Buy tickets online in advance and arrive at opening to ride the big coasters before lines build.

florida_aquarium.name: The Florida Aquarium
florida_aquarium.hours: Daily roughly 09:30–17:00; check on the day
florida_aquarium.tip: Book a timed ticket online and go early; the touch tanks and wetlands gallery are the highlights.

checkers.name: Checkers / Rally's
checkers.price_text: ≈ $6–12 per person for burgers and fries
checkers.hours: Varies by branch; most drive-thrus open late
checkers.tip: A cheap, fast drive-thru burger stop; there are several branches around Tampa, so pick the one nearest you.

geopoliticus.name: Geopoliticus Child Watching the Birth of the New Man
geopoliticus.landmark: Geopoliticus Child Watching the Birth of the New Man
geopoliticus.hours: Usually Tue–Sun daytime; check on the day
geopoliticus.tip: This Dalí painting hangs in The Dalí Museum in St. Petersburg; allow extra time for the rest of the collection.

riverwalk.name: Tampa Riverwalk
riverwalk.hours: Open 24 hours; best in daylight and early evening
riverwalk.tip: Walk the 2.6-mile path between Channelside and downtown; it links the aquarium, museums and parks.

ybor_walk.name: Ybor City historic district walk
ybor_walk.price_text: Free to wander; food and drinks extra
ybor_walk.hours: Streets always open; shops and bars vary
ybor_walk.tip: Go by day for the cigar shops and brick streets, and stay into the evening for bars and live music.

tampa_theatre.name: Tampa Theatre
tampa_theatre.price_text: ≈ $10–20 depending on the film or event
tampa_theatre.tip: Catch a classic film in this 1926 movie palace; the interior alone is worth the ticket.

armature_works.name: Armature Works food hall
armature_works.tip: Many stalls under one roof plus a riverfront lawn; good for groups with different tastes.

tampa_museum.name: Tampa Museum of Art
tampa_museum.price_text: ≈ $10–20 adult; check current price and free days
tampa_museum.tip: Small, calm collection on the river; pair it with a Riverwalk stroll.

sparkman_wharf.name: Sparkman Wharf
sparkman_wharf.hours: Varies by vendor; busiest evenings and weekends
sparkman_wharf.tip: Outdoor container food stalls and a lawn next to the aquarium; go for sunset and live music.

bayshore.name: Bayshore Boulevard walk
bayshore.tip: Long waterfront sidewalk with skyline views; go early morning to beat the heat and the joggers.

hyde_park.name: Hyde Park Village
hyde_park.price_text: Free to browse; food and drink extra
hyde_park.tip: Leafy shopping streets and cafés; a relaxed break between downtown sights.

zoo_tampa.name: ZooTampa at Lowry Park
zoo_tampa.hours: Daily roughly 09:30–17:00; check on the day
zoo_tampa.tip: Good family half-day with manatees and Florida wildlife; bring sun protection.

clearwater_beach.name: Clearwater Beach day trip
clearwater_beach.price_text: Free beach; parking and food extra
clearwater_beach.tip: About 45 minutes west of Tampa; arrive early for parking and stay for the sunset at Pier 60.

cuban_sandwich.name: Cuban sandwich lunch in Ybor City
cuban_sandwich.hours: Most delis and cafés open lunchtime; check on the day
cuban_sandwich.tip: Order a pressed Cuban and a café con leche; the historic cigar-district spots are the classic choice.

pirate_water.name: Pirate Water Taxi
pirate_water.hours: Roughly late morning to evening; seasonal
pirate_water.tip: Hop-on hop-off boat linking downtown, Channelside and Ybor; a cheap way to see the skyline from the water.

curtis_hixon.name: Curtis Hixon Waterfront Park
curtis_hixon.hours: Open daily; fountains and events vary
curtis_hixon.tip: Green lawn on the Riverwalk with a playground and fountains; good rest stop with kids.

glazer_childrens.name: Glazer Children's Museum
glazer_childrens.hours: Usually Tue–Sun; check on the day
glazer_childrens.tip: Hands-on indoor option for younger kids, especially on rainy or very hot days.

st_pete_dali.name: The Dalí Museum (St. Petersburg)
st_pete_dali.hours: Usually daily; check on the day
st_pete_dali.tip: Across the bay in St. Petersburg; allow half a day with the drive and the waterfront gardens.

cigar_factory.name: Cigar shop and rolling demo in Ybor City
cigar_factory.price_text: Free to look; cigars cost extra
cigar_factory.hours: Shop hours vary; check on the day
cigar_factory.tip: Watch a roller at work and buy a souvenir; ask before taking photos.

sunday_market.name: Tampa Downtown Market (weekend)
sunday_market.price_text: Free entry; food and goods extra
sunday_market.hours: Weekend mornings; confirm dates on the day
sunday_market.tip: Local produce, food stalls and crafts; check that it is running before you go.

amalie_arena.name: Amalie Arena event
amalie_arena.tip: Check the schedule for Lightning hockey or a concert; book ahead for weekend games.

lettuce_lake.name: Lettuce Lake Park boardwalk
lettuce_lake.price_text: Small per-vehicle entry fee; check on the day
lettuce_lake.hours: Daily daytime hours; check on the day
lettuce_lake.tip: Flat boardwalk through cypress swamp; bring bug spray and go early for wildlife.

gasp_parilla.name: Columbia Restaurant, Ybor City
gasp_parilla.hours: Lunch and dinner daily; check on the day
gasp_parilla.tip: Florida's oldest restaurant; try the Cuban sandwich or the 1905 salad, and book for dinner.

styles.label: Culture
styles.blurb: Ybor City, the Tampa Museum of Art and the Riverwalk.

styles.label: Food
styles.blurb: Cuban sandwiches, deviled crab and Gulf seafood.

styles.label: Beaches
styles.blurb: Clearwater and St. Pete beaches, an easy drive west.

stays.why: Walk to the Riverwalk, museums and arenas. Streetcar to Ybor is free.
Historic cigar district with bars and Cuban food. Livelier at night, quieter by day.
Waterfront near the Florida Aquarium and cruise terminal. Short walk to downtown.
Closest to the airport and the big mall. Good for early flights and rental cars.

food: Get a Cuban sandwich at a Ybor City lunch counter. Expect pressed pork, ham and pickles for roughly $10–15.
Try deviled crab and Spanish bean soup at old Ybor cafeterias. Budget about $10–20 a plate.
Gulf seafood is the local pick: grouper, stone crab in season and shrimp. Prices vary; check the day's catch.
Food halls and Riverwalk cafés are easy for mixed groups. Expect $15–25 a main.
Summer heat is strong. Drink water often and plan a long indoor lunch during afternoon storms.
more_time: Add a beach day: drive west to Clearwater or St. Pete Beach, roughly 40–60 minutes. Check traffic on the bridges.
Busch Gardens Tampa Bay fills a full day for thrill rides and animals. Check ticket prices and opening hours on the day.
Swap a city afternoon for the Florida Aquarium or a Tampa Bay history museum if it rains.
